questions.question: What is the ratio of 6 red beads to 9 blue beads in simplest form?
Which equation is a proportion?
If 4 notebooks cost $12, what is the cost per notebook?
What value of x satisfies x/5 = 6/10?
Which ratio is equivalent to 3:4?
A speed of 60 miles in 2 hours corresponds to what unit rate?
What is a part-to-whole ratio for 3 red balls and 5 blue balls?
Why must corresponding quantities match when forming a proportion?
choices: Every numerator must be larger than its denominator
The denominators must always be equal
Each ratio must compare the same kinds of quantities in the same order

questions.question: Which relationship is proportional?
A proportional relationship has y/x = 2 for nonzero x. What does 2 represent?
choices: The total number of ordered pairs
The value of x in every pair

questions.question: A table contains (2, 6), (4, 12), and (6, 18). Which equation fits?
Why does a proportional graph pass through the origin?
choices: Every straight line must pass through the origin
Zero input corresponds to zero output in y = kx
The constant k must be zero

questions.question: If two ratios are equivalent, what is true of their cross products?
choices: The cross products must be zero
The cross products differ by one

questions.question: How does doubling both terms of a nonzero ratio affect its value?
choices: It adds two to the ratio

questions.question: A drink uses juice and water in a 1:3 ratio. What fraction of the drink is juice?
A map scale is 1 cm to 5 km. What distance does 7 cm represent?
A recipe for four people uses 6 cups of broth. How many cups serve ten people at the same rate?
A store sells 5 pens for $4 and another sells 8 pens for $6. Which has the lower unit price?
choices: Both have the same unit price

questions.question: Three workers finish identical independent tasks at the same rate, producing 18 items per hour together. How many do five workers produce per hour?
A taxi charges a $4 starting fee plus $2 per mile. Why is total cost not proportional to miles?
choices: The starting fee makes the graph miss the origin
The cost cannot be written as an equation
Any relationship involving money is nonproportional
